text:
miriam: Quick heads-up — launch posts went out this morning but the dashboard shows a weird pattern: CTR up ~40% but MQLs down 18% on the same cohort :thinking_face:

sam: seen it, akshay flagged a tagging mismatch earlier. which dashboard are you looking at?

miriam: Pulse > Launch Posts > last 24h (link: https://redwood.prod/dash/launch_posts). Time series spikes around 09:12 UTC, CTR spike is concentrated in social referrer.

jordan: hmm could be utm_source normalization bug — we had a recent regex change in the ingestion lambda.

alex: @miriam can you paste the top referrers / utm strings?

miriam: top rows: social_twitter, twitter.com, twitter%20organic, t.co, twr. A bunch of near-duplicates.

nina: that explains CTR inflation (dup rows counted separately) but not MQL drop — maybe routing to wrong form/landing?

sam: check inbound routing rules — last deploy yesterday changed the fallback for unknown utm_medium to 'social' instead of null. could affect attribution logic for MQL join.

insights-bot: automated alert: sample_rate change detected for /lead_submit between 08:55 and 09:05 UTC. previous sample_rate=1.0 now=0.3. see /alerts/12345

jordan: oh — sampling reduced leads ingestion for a 10min window. that could drop raw MQLs while CTR upstream (clicks) remained intact.

miriam: so hypothesis: duplicate UTM parsing boosted CTR metric; sampling reduced MQL ingestion window => apparent mismatch.

alex: action items: 1) revert sampling to 1.0 for the window and backfill if possible (eng-infra). 2) normalize utm_source values in the dashboard query (analytics). 3) audit inbound routing for that cohort (ops).

sam: tagging the infra oncall @eng-infra, will open a runbook ticket.

insights-bot: ticket created: INF-8792 (backfill lead events), owner: eng-infra-oncall.

nina: for the weekly KPI review on Monday we should call out this anomaly and show corrected vs uncorrected numbers. saves freakout from execs.

jordan: I'll prepare a small viz: current vs normalized utm and raw leads vs backfilled leads (SQL below).

jordan: ```sql
SELECT utm_source_normalized, count(*) AS clicks, sum(is_mql) AS mqls
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-15 12:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY mqls DESC;
```

miriam: perfect. can you also include a quick note about how sampling interacts with routing? that was the part folks didn't expect.

sam: will do — short bullets in the deck. also re: messaging iteration, we should pause the second wave of launch posts until we confirm attribution is stable.

alex: +1. pause scheduled posts at 11:00 UTC? I can hold them.

miriam: please hold. and @nina please update Monday's agenda to include a 10-min anomaly readout.

nina: done — added slide 3.

miriam: thanks team. once backfill is complete, let's compare week-over-week and decide whether the messaging cadence needs an immediate tweak or just a note for next sprint. :thumbsup:

insights-bot: backfill complete: INF-8792. estimate accuracy restored to 99.7% for impacted window.

jordan: uploaded corrected viz to the shared drive https://drive.redwood/launchsigs/normalized-viz.png

sam: closing loop: sampling change was an automated mitigation for ingestion lag, will add a guard to avoid turning on sampling during high-traffic campaigns.

miriam: great. I'll summarize in the KPI thread and mark as FYI for leadership.
